description: TempMail Pro — A full-featured temporary/disposable email SaaS platform for WordPress with subscriptions, multi-domain, payments, and analytics.
changelog:
v2.0.1 — 2026-05-22

IMAP · MIME · RESPONSIVE · SPEED · GUIDE

  • New: New: parse_mime_parts() recursive MIME parser — correctly extracts HTML and plain-text from multipart/alternative and multipart/mixed emails (fixes "No HTML content" for n8n, ImprovMX, Gmail emails).
  • New: New: Burst polling mode — after a new email is detected, the frontend re-polls every 5 seconds for 30 seconds to catch follow-up emails instantly.
  • New: New: Refresh button now triggers a live IMAP server fetch (not just a DB read), so clicking Refresh immediately checks for new mail.
  • New: New: Background IMAP poll interval reduced from 30 s to 15 s for faster automatic email delivery.
  • New: New: Responsive email rendering — inline min-width and fixed pixel widths stripped via JS DOM pass before rendering, eliminating horizontal scrollbars on mobile.
  • New: New: Mail Server Setup Guide card added to admin Setup Guide page with 4 hosting-type tabs (Shared Hosting, VPS/Dedicated, ImprovMX, Mailgun Webhook).
  • New: New: WP-Cron Setup step (Step 8) added to the admin Setup Guide with interactive tabs for aaPanel, cPanel, and SSH — commands auto-filled with your site URL.
  • New: New: Setup Guide progress bar updated to 8 milestones; WP-Cron step shows live status of DISABLE_WP_CRON.
  • Fixed: Fixed: poll_socket_imap() completely rewritten to use universal RFC822 fetch instead of server-specific BODY[HEADER]/BODY[TEXT] — now works on all IMAP servers including shared hosting.
  • Fixed: Fixed: Orphaned duplicate code block (old poll body) removed from class-tempmail-imap.php that caused a fatal parse error on live servers.
  • Fixed: Fixed: Domain-targeted IMAP SEARCH (SEARCH TO "yourdomain.com") added to reduce polling load and improve message matching accuracy.
  • Fixed: Fixed: Email regex changed from .+?@ to .*?@ — bare addresses (no display name) now matched correctly.
  • Fixed: Fixed: rsort() applied to IMAP sequence numbers so newest 50 messages are always processed (previously kept oldest).
  • Fixed: Fixed: HTML email tab showing "No HTML content" for multipart emails — caused by flat body decode that ignored MIME boundaries.
  • Fixed: Fixed: Email iframe horizontal scrollbar — email templates with hardcoded width="600" and min-width:600px now scale to fit the viewer panel.
  • Fixed: Fixed: Refresh button spinner duration increased to 1.2 s to match actual IMAP fetch time.

v2.0.0 — 2026-05-17

SUBSCRIPTIONS · PAYMENTS · ANALYTICS · API · OAUTH

  • New: New: Subscription plans (Free / Starter / Pro / Business) with per-plan limits on inboxes, lifetime, storage, and domain access.
  • New: New: Multi-domain management — assign domains to categories (Free / Premium / VIP) and control access by plan.
  • New: New: Stripe & PayPal payment gateways with webhook verification and subscription lifecycle handling.
  • New: New: bKash & SSLCommerz Bangladesh local payment gateways.
  • New: New: API key system — developers can generate personal access tokens and query the REST API.
  • New: New: Ad monetization manager with placements (Top Banner, Inbox Sidebar, Between Emails) and CTR tracking.
  • New: New: Magic link authentication + Google OAuth social login.
  • New: New: User dashboard with full inbox history, plan status, and subscription management.
  • New: New: REST API v1 — addresses, emails, plans, domains, and webhook receiver endpoints.
  • New: New: Real server-cron endpoint for background IMAP polling on shared hosting.
  • New: New: Gutenberg block and Elementor widget support.
  • New: New: Dark / light mode toggle with premium gradient UI.
  • New: New: QR code generator for easy inbox sharing.
  • New: New: Analytics dashboard with revenue tracking and Chart.js graphs.
  • New: New: Configure Mail Server UI — sectioned IMAP/POP3/Webhook settings with live connection test.
  • New: New: Admin settings redesigned as card-based sections matching the Mail Server design system.
  • Fixed: Fixed: UTC_TIMESTAMP() used consistently for all MySQL expiry comparisons to avoid timezone drift.
  • Fixed: Fixed: Sandboxed iframe for HTML email rendering prevents CSS/JS injection from email content.
  • Fixed: Fixed: Plain-text fallback now correctly extracted from HTML body when text part is absent.
  • Fixed: Fixed: imap_pass and spam_filter fields now properly persisted in the settings save handler.
  • Fixed: Fixed: Save All Settings button $(this) scope bug — button now correctly re-enables after AJAX completes.
